text:
Michelle (PM): Hey team — quick design review request. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/org-access-panel. Focus: roles matrix density, invite modal flow (email + link), SSO toggle placement, and audit log nav. Can you drop quick nits? Trying to merge by EOD.
Alex (Eng): Skimming — love the compact roles table. Two infra notes: 1) SSO toggle should not flip org-wide auth alone, that needs explicit SSO config step; suggest we move the toggle to the SSO section with a small affordance in org settings: `Manage SSO` button. 2) Batched invites need backend flag — will add TODO.
Sam (Design): Copy nits: change "Manage billing" to "Billing access"; replace "Can admin" with "Admin privileges" for clarity. Also roles table row height feels tight for keyboard focus — increase to 48px min for comfortable target. Contrast: the gray hint text in the invite input fails 4.5:1 on some screens.
Tina (Customer Success): +1 on invite link expiry visibility. Customers keep asking for default expiry options (24h, 7d, never). Also callout: SOC2 customers asked for explicit audit retention link in the UI.
Jordan (Security): Audit log nav: add filters for "by user", "by action", and "by resource" up front. Also we should add an "Export" CTA near the top-right with a confirmation modal that mentions retention policy. Regarding SSO toggle — if kept, it must have an inline warning: "Enabling SSO will disable password-based logins for all users".
Olivia (QA): Accessibility checklist: invite modal must be `role=dialog`, focus trap on open, `aria-labelledby` pointing to modal title, and success message announced via `aria-live="polite"`. Keyboard steps: tab order should go Email -> Role select -> Send button -> Close. Also test with screen readers on large role lists (virtualize list).
Alex (Eng): Example small code snippet for the toggle aria-label: ` <button role=\"switch\" aria-checked=\"false\" aria-label=\"Enable SSO for this organization\">` . And add visible focus outline: `:focus { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }`.
Sam (Design): Proposed microcopy for invite modal: Title: "Invite teammates". Email placeholder: "name@company.com". Role dropdown default: "Select role — Viewer, Editor, Admin". Success toast: "Invites sent — recipients will receive an email with steps." Can we make the toast persistent for 6s?
Michelle (PM): Great drafts — Olivia, can you run keyboard/screen reader pass? Jordan, any objections to the Export CTA copy: "Export audit (CSV)"?
Jordan (Security): "Export audit (CSV)" is fine, but require: exports are admins-only, and we log export initiator in audit. Add that sentence to the export modal copy.
Olivia (QA): I'll run the a11y pass and upload a short checklist by 11:30. Also will test tabbing through the roles matrix and ensure row-level actions are reachable via keyboard (kebab menu needs `aria-haspopup`).
Tina (Customer Success): Small UX ask: when admin generates an invite link show a tooltip: "Link expires in 7 days — change in link settings" so customers don't accidentally share unlimited links.
Sam (Design): Accessibility visual tweak: increase toggle hit area to 44px and add text label next to switch: "SSO (SAML)" rather than just icon. Also add status chip: "Enabled / Disabled" for clarity.
Michelle (PM): Ok next steps: Sam update Figma with copy and spacing changes; Alex file backend ticket for batched invites and export guardrails; Jordan confirm audit log retention language; Olivia send a11y checklist; Tina I'll add a short note to the support KB. Thanks all — dropping a follow-up once Figma is updated. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: A new branch `feature/org-access-ui` was created by alex — build pipeline started.
Alex (Eng): Pushing a small PR with aria-label and focus outline in ~30m. Will ping when ready for review.
Michelle (PM): If anyone has any last-minute UI wording, post it here, otherwise I'll merge changes into the sprint ticket this afternoon.
